claim: In the matching retail DLL, PlayerController_AI.CalcTouchTime (0x06004FFE) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 129-byte body. It loads COMLevelDataManager.inst.touchTimePrm_Base, touchTimePrm_Coefficient, and touchTimePrm_RandomRange into locals. It returns immediately when PlObj compares equal to null or when PlObj.WresParam is null. Otherwise it loads PlObj.WresParam.aiParam, calls the already-closed Int32 MatchRandom.Range overload with exact arguments -touchTimePrm_RandomRange and touchTimePrm_RandomRange+1, then computes local5 = touchTimePrm_Base + Int32((100 - aiParam.touchCond) * touchTimePrm_Coefficient) + sampledRandom and stores touchFrm = local5 * 30 before returning. FACT-0045 pins CalcTouchTime as the false branch of InitAllWorks(create_init), and the matching PlayerController_AI.UpdatePlayer body also contains a callvirt to CalcTouchTime at IL+0x0034.
